prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young man lies on his side on a sun-bleached, expansive rooftop, his body curled slightly as if exhausted or lost in thought. He wears a crisp white shirt with bold, geometric brown and black patterns on the sleeves, paired with dark trousers. A gold wristwatch glints subtly on his left wrist. His expression is pensive and distant, eyes half-open, gazing past the small handheld video camera he clutches loosely in his right hand, the device resting against the concrete. The midday sunlight casts sharp, natural shadows, emphasizing the texture of the rooftop and the contours of his face. The background is softly out of focus, revealing a row of indistinct, modern rooftop structures under a pale blue sky, evoking a sense of isolation and quiet introspection. The color palette is cool and muted, dominated by soft blues, grays, and earth tones, with a cinematic, almost melancholic atmosphere. The camera angle is low and intimate, positioned at ground level to heighten the emotional immediacy and vulnerability of the subject, with a shallow depth of field that draws all attention to the young man and his solitary moment.
